description: This PHP source file implements JWT (JSON Web Token) verification, including signature validation, token data validation, and related utility functions for handling JWTs within a web UI authentication context.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Main function to verify a JWT token by splitting into segments, verifying the signature, and validating token data.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the JWT's signature using fetched public keys and ensures the token's signature matches the header and payload.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Validates the token payload's time claims and tenant ID to ensure token validity.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes the public key to a file from a given key string.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token-related data and statuses to a specific log file for debugging or auditing.

methods.name: base64decode_url
methods.description: Decodes URL-safe base64 encoded strings, used for decoding parts of the JWT.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if a file's modification time is within the last four hours to consider the key file valid.
